meta.score_scale: 0-10 per dimension; composite scaled to 0-100 Buyer-Fit

fields.reg: S = south of river, N = north of river
fields.band: true = suburb median sits within or below the $800k-$1.1M band

meta.note: Medians are ranges, not precise values. Block-size suitability (500sqm+) must be confirmed per-listing via Landgate.

suburbs.name: Shelley
suburbs.why: Affordable entry to the Rossmoyne SHS catchment, near the river, strong family demand. The best growth-after-dip hold - scarce land plus school demand insulate it from the investor-led Budget drag.

suburbs.name: Wilson
suburbs.why: Larger City of Canning blocks, Curtin-adjacent, among the closest at-budget options to Como. Strong knock-down-rebuild margin.

suburbs.name: Parkwood
suburbs.why: Big blocks, value, family, strong recent growth. Slightly further from Como than Wilson or St James.

suburbs.name: St James
suburbs.why: Near Victoria Park and the Curtin precinct; value with knock-down-rebuild upside; genuinely close to Como.

suburbs.name: Bentley
suburbs.why: The value play - cheapest near-in, biggest margin of safety, strongest KDR economics. Some pockets less polished; that's the trade for price.

suburbs.name: Riverton
suburbs.why: Rossmoyne SHS catchment and family-friendly, sitting at the top of the band. Scarce school-zone land makes it a strong growth-after-dip hold; listing prices are estimates, so the odd one a touch over is still worth a look.

suburbs.name: Manning
suburbs.why: Same postcode as Como, walking distance, big blocks - but out of budget for a house now. Aspirational reference only.

suburbs.name: Como
suburbs.why: The anchor itself. Houses are well over budget; only villas and units sit under $1.0M here. Included for reference.

suburbs.name: Dianella
suburbs.why: Best north-of-river balance of land and location - big original blocks, Mt Lawley-adjacent. The distance from Como is the catch.

suburbs.name: Bayswater
suburbs.why: METRONET hub, gentrifying, near the river. Borderline budget and a fair way from Como.

suburbs.name: Embleton
suburbs.why: North-of-river value with big blocks near Inglewood and Bayswater. Far from Como.

suburbs.name: Balcatta
suburbs.why: North-of-river, freeway access, family, value. Far from Como.

suburbs.name: Nollamara
suburbs.why: Value and gentrifying - target original un-subdivided lots. Biggest northern margin of safety, but farthest from Como.

suburbs.name: Westminster
suburbs.why: Cheapest near-in north, next to Tuart Hill. Strong growth; far from Como.
